title: Over every finite field other than F2, the slice, geometric and analytic ranks of a three-tensor satisfy SR at most three GR at most 8.13 AR
author: Alex Cohen and Guy Moshkovitz
difficulty_reason: After the exact classical tangent-dimension, determinantal-ideal and perfect-field stable-rank descent prerequisites, the author still constructs a common slice decomposition for an entire tangent matrix space and couples it to maximal-dimensional low-rank sections. A separate full argument turns degree/Bezout control and equidimensional envelopes into codimension-exponential finite-field zero-fibre bounds. Both remaining structural and uniform counting arguments are substantive beyond routine qualification substitutions, yielding conservative H1 for the combined original rank inequality.
work: Structure vs. Randomness for Bilinear Maps

source_check.note: Only original Theorem 1 in its historical finite-field scope excluding F\_2 is selected: SR(T)<=3 GR(T)<=8.13 AR(T) for every three-tensor. The broader perfect-field first inequality is retained as original context, not separately counted. Original full rank definitions, Sections 2--4, common tangent slice decomposition, linear-section induction, exact base-field descent invocation, full generalized Schwartz-Zippel proof and final character-average/rank closing are included. Ordinary prerequisites are Harris/Shafarevich tangent and dimension basics; Bruns--Vetter Theorem 2.10 and Nullstellensatz for determinantal ideals; Derksen [11, Theorem 2.5, Corollary 3.7 and Proposition 4.9] stable-rank descent over perfect fields (the complete authored combination and explicitly titled proof sketch are retained); Kopparty--Moshkovitz--Zuiddam [30, Theorem 3.1 and Lemma 4.2] geometric-rank fibre characterization/invariance; overdetermined Bezout as [39, Theorem 5]; Bukh--Tsimerman [6, Lemma 14]/Dvir--Kollar--Lovett [13, Claim 7.2] point-degree bound; and Kollar [29, Theorem 1.5] generic-combination complete-intersection envelope. No source-local new argument is treated as an external prerequisite. Authored literal fields in the P,Q paragraph at 406 and minor-product display at 421, and the tensor-space V\_2 membership footnote at 172 are preserved without a mathematical verdict or repair.
